Genesis for Analogue Pocket – licences

The core is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3
(GPL-3.0-only), as a whole: most of it is GPL-3.0-or-later, and the files of
MiSTer's Genesis core with no header of their own are under that core's
GPL-3.0. The source of the bitstream in this folder, and the licence's full
text, are at https://github.com/Frazilpop/Genesis-Pocket (THIRD-PARTY.md lists
each part). It is MiSTer's Genesis core (MiSTer-devel/Genesis_MiSTer, GPL-3.0)
on the Pocket: fpgagen's VDP, Jorge Cwik's FX68K, Daniel Wallner's T80, Jose
Tejada's jt12 and jt89 and the SVP by Sergey Dvodnenko and Sorgelig.

The bitstream carries the parts below, whose licences ask for their notices
to go with it. The Analogizer module's Y/C encoder (yc_out, Mike Simone,
GPL-2.0-or-later), scandoubler (Till Harbaum, GPL-3.0-or-later) and VGA
output (after MiSTer's vga_out, Sorgelig, GPL) are under the GPL as well. The
Pocket framework round the console is Analogue's openFPGA core template,
under Analogue's APF Software License Agreement.

vdp_common.vhd, system.sv, gen_io.sv), and MiSTer's multitaps (fourway.v,
multitap.sv, teamplayer.sv)
